text:
Itemized estimates of what was served:

| Item | kcal | Protein (g) | Carbs (g) | Fat (g) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sushi, 7 pieces (shrimp/vegetable roll) | 300 | 9 | 55 | 5 |
| Toasted sandwich (grilled cheese style, likely with butter) | 450 | 16 | 40 | 24 |
| Cookie | 200 | 2 | 28 | 9 |
| Cola, about 300 ml | 120 | 0 | 32 | 0 |
| Soy sauce | 10 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Pickled ginger | 10 | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| **Total served** | **1090** | **28** | **158** | **38** |

For the leftovers, I assumed about 90 kcal would remain, such as some soy sauce, ginger and a bit of crust or drink. Subtracting that gives about 1000 kcal eaten. The macronutrients scale down proportionally, to roughly 26 g protein, 145 g carbohydrate and 35 g fat.
